items.title: How Watch Duty is using Gemini to get wildfire alerts out faster
items.content: Watch Duty uses Gemini to turn noisy fire radio into text, spotting wildfire dispatches in under 30 seconds so alerts go out faster.
items.contentSnippet: Watch Duty uses Gemini to turn noisy fire radio into text, spotting wildfire dispatches in under 30 seconds so alerts go out faster.

summaries.zh: Watch Duty利用Gemini技术将嘈杂的火警无线电转为文本，能在30秒内识别出野火调度信息，从而加快警报发布速度。该系统能有效处理噪音干扰，提高信息提取效率，确保快速响应。
summaries.en: Watch Duty employs Gemini to convert noisy fire radio broadcasts into text, enabling it to identify wildfire dispatches within 30 seconds. This technology accelerates alert dissemination, ensuring faster response times.

items.summary: Watch Duty利用Gemini技术将嘈杂的火警无线电转为文本，能在30秒内识别出野火调度信息，从而加快警报发布速度。该系统能有效处理噪音干扰，提高信息提取效率，确保快速响应。

items.title: Walter Isaacson on curiosity and creativity in the AI age.
items.content: Walter Isaacson joins Google to discuss how history’s greatest innovators inspire creativity and human judgment in the AI age. Watch the episode.
items.contentSnippet: Walter Isaacson joins Google to discuss how history’s greatest innovators inspire creativity and human judgment in the AI age. Watch the episode.

summaries.zh: 瓦尔特·艾萨克森在谷歌探讨了历史上伟大创新者如何启发人工智能时代的创造力和人类判断力。他强调了好奇心在创新中的重要性，并分析了AI与人类智慧的协同关系。艾萨克森认为，历史中的创新者通过不断探索和质疑，推动了科技进步。他呼吁在AI时代保持好奇心，以激发创造力。
summaries.en: Walter Isaacson discusses the role of curiosity and creativity in the AI era during his talk at Google. He explores how historical innovators can inspire creativity and human judgment alongside artificial intelligence. The event includes a video of the discussion.

items.summary: 瓦尔特·艾萨克森在谷歌探讨了历史上伟大创新者如何启发人工智能时代的创造力和人类判断力。他强调了好奇心在创新中的重要性，并分析了AI与人类智慧的协同关系。艾萨克森认为，历史中的创新者通过不断探索和质疑，推动了科技进步。他呼吁在AI时代保持好奇心，以激发创造力。
